newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA UNCHANGED FOR SECOND TEST.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA UNCHANGED FOR SECOND TEST.

text.p: South Africa on Wednesday retained the team which beat Argentina 46-15 last Saturday for the second test next Saturday.
Springbok manager Andre Markgraaf gave a vote of confidence for both the team and the reserve bench despite an impressive 89-19 win by the reserve side in Mendoza on Tuesday night.
It is the first time since he took over from Kitch Christie in May that Markgraaff has been able to name the same team for two tests in a row. Previously a catalogue of injuries disrupted his plans.
The management has decided to keep lock Krynauw Otto and hooker Chris Rossouw with the squad for a week in the hope that injuries they sustained against Cuyo on Tuesday will clear up.
Rossouw wrenched ankle ligaments and looks unlikely to complete the tour but Otto is expected to recover sufficiently from the effects of a punch on the jaw to remain with the squad.

15-Andre Joubert; 14-James Small, 13-Japie Mulder, 12-Hennie le Roux, 11-Jacques Olivier; 10-Henry Honiball, 9-Joost van der Westhuizen; 8-Gary Teichmann (captain), 7-Andre Venter, 6-Ruben Kruger, 5-Mark Andrews, 4-Kobus Wiese, 3-Adrian Garvey, 2-James Dalton, 1-Dawie Theron.
Replacements: Andre Snyman, Kevin Putt, Fritz van Heerden, Wayne Fyvie, Toks van der Linde, Henry Tromp.
